justification: The connectionRequest check in evaluation/holdout-score.ts matches words literally. In two missions FORGE asked to connect the right resource under a different name: core-073 asked for email reading (missing: email.read) where the oracle names "gmail"; core-076 asked for sending text messages (missing: sms.send) where the oracle names "SMS delivery". PROTOCOL.md requires identifying the materially missing resource, which both do. core-078 (asked for calendar.create where a learning portal was missing) stays a failure.
